stories.title: Sources: Rockets, Thompson agree to $208M deal
stories.summary: Houston Rockets guard Amen Thompson has agreed to a five-year, $208 million rookie-scale contract extension with the franchise, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Clippers docked 5 first-round picks, fined $30M
stories.summary: Following an investigation into a Kawhi Leonard sponsorship, the NBA docked the Clippers five first-round picks, fined them $30 million and suspended owner Steve Ballmer for a year. The Clippers plan to challenge the findings "through every avenue."

stories.title: Athletic: Russini-Vrabel ties violated standards
stories.summary: Former Athletic reporter Dianna Russini's relationship with Mike Vrabel violated newsroom standards but showed no clear bias toward the Patriots head coach, the Athletic said Thursday.
